rows.method_as_published: mVMC with SU(2) and symmetry projections
Generalized RVB ansatz, unrestricted VMC optimization (no quantum-number projection)
rows.bound_type_reason: variational ansatz; energy is a strict upper bound (assigned during source verification)
rows.reference: Closely competing valence bond crystal orders in the ground state of the spin-1/2 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the pyrochlore lattice: a large scale unrestricted variational study, arXiv:2509.13746

verified.method: arXiv PDF text extracted locally with pypdf in layout mode, no LLM transcription
verified.reported_as: E0 ~ -0.4855 J/site, approximate, no error bar
verified.note: Sec. A: "The obtained ground state energy is E0 ~ -0.5118 J/site for the L = 2 cluster and E0 ~ -0.4855 J/site for the L = 4 cluster", periodic boundary conditions on both; the L = 4 cluster carries Nv = 4N^2 = 262144 parameters, so N = 256. Units: the same passage quotes the mVMC energy -0.5162 J/site for L = 2, which is the pyrochlore-2x2x2_32_P record -0.516266 in the S.S per-site convention. Approximate and without an error bar, so it is eligible for nothing (RULES.md 6). It is nonetheless 0.5% below the VarBench mVMC record -0.4830957, although the ansatz has no symmetry projection and sits above mVMC at L = 2 - which says more about that record than about this row. 2026-09-19: the authors measured the fixed state on request, E/N = -0.4855840(29) J with Var(H) = 4.894(22) J^2 (see corrections and error_metrics on this row); with a sigma it is eligible and holds the variational record on this instance.

corrections.location: sources/2509.13746-authors-pyro-result.dat, the authors' dedicated Monte Carlo measurement of the optimized L = 4 state (Rong Cheng, 2026-09-19; README in sources/2509.13746-authors-README_QMBL.txt)
corrections.version_read: private correspondence, data files as received 2026-09-19 (zip sha256 da066f4b244e886c82bf347a2b5e43cecd0e12369ccfa240b809170c71b79dcc)
corrections.conversion: S.S total x 4 = Pauli total; per site -0.48558404568894675 x 1024
corrections.reason: The paper gives the energy as approximate to four decimals; the authors measured the same fixed state with 8,388,608 samples over 256 chains and obtained E/N = -0.4855840(29) J, one unit of the last printed digit below the printed value and 29 sigma of the new error bar, so a sigma cannot sit on the printed number. Corrected to the measured value with the printed one kept here (ruling 2026-09-19, Tristan).

error_metrics.source: the authors' dedicated Monte Carlo measurement of the optimized L = 4 state, sent by Rong Cheng on 2026-09-19 for the QMBL entry (private correspondence, via Tao Li); outputs as received in sources/2509.13746-authors-pyro-result.dat, -pyro-blocking.dat, -pyro-chains.dat, README in sources/2509.13746-authors-README_QMBL.txt
error_metrics.note: H = J sum S_i.S_j, J = 1, 256 sites, periodic. One standard error of the energy from the dispersion of 256 independently seeded chain means (1000 warmup sweeps, 32768 samples per chain at one sweep each, 8,388,608 samples), checked against temporal blocking: 2.867e-6 at blocks of 1024 and 2.84e-6 to 2.92e-6 for every block size >= 256 (pyro-blocking.dat), so RULES.md 6 is met. Var(H) = <|E_loc|^2> - <Re E_loc>^2 of the total S.S Hamiltonian, complex wavefunction, +/- 0.022 J^2 by block jackknife (one run; the authors note the variance error is more sensitive to high-second-moment chains than the energy error and is not yet confirmed by a second run). Stored as Pauli total, x 16. The row's energy is the same measurement (corrections on the row), so the agreement check is exact. Measurement cost: 256 MPI ranks x 674 s.
